description: For one domain or URL, return how often AI answer engines cite it: overall citation rate, the rate on each engine (overall.byEngine: cited runs, that engine's observed runs, and whether the engine's sample clears the evidence floor), confidence tier, rank among all cited domains and within its source role, and per-category segment rates. Use to answer 'does ChatGPT cite <site>' or 'what share of Perplexity runs cite <site>'. A published byEngine row with runsCited 0 means that engine did not cite the domain. byEngine is the whole window, not a rate inside one category.

domain.description: A domain (techcrunch.com) or any URL on it.

title: How often AI engines cite a site

description: Ranked sources one answer engine cites. Without category, rates use that engine's whole-window runs; collectionRegime, when present, separately reports sources since a collection change. Pass category for an engine-and-category leaderboard. An engine-and-category leaderboard uses that engine's own observed runs in the category's published segments across the release window. Older releases without category-by-engine counts instead rank whole-window rates among sources with a published segment in that category. Read the returned scope and denominator; collecting categories or engine samples below the evidence floor publish no ranking. rateScope is within_category for category-by-engine counts, or whole_window_among_published_segments for the older fallback. total counts the available rows; each source's rankTotal is the full ranked population, which may be larger. Use to answer 'what sources does Perplexity cite most?' or 'which sources does Google AI Overviews cite in <category>?'.

category.description: Optional category key. Returns an engine-and-category leaderboard; read rateScope and the returned denominator.

cursor.description: Page token from the previous response's next.cursor. When set, offset is ignored.

engine.description: Engine key from mri_list_engines: chatgpt, claude, gemini, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overviews, perplexity.
